categories.name: Experimental
categories.description: These features are extremely experimental and may cause unexpected crashes.

plugins.name: Zoidium Core
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Hidden built-in extensions that always run. Not shown in the Plugins panel and never stored in projects.

plugins.name: Easing+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: A normalized cubic Bezier editor with a focused set of reusable presets.

plugins.name: Expressions+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Modern deterministic expressions, property links and Sequence Controls in native CM3 panels.
plugins.warning: Extended expressions and controls require Zoidium with Expressions+.

plugins.name: Shader+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Native custom shader controls with optional baked texture inputs.

plugins.name: Player+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds drawing pause, single-render, and preview quality controls to the playback bar.

plugins.name: Assets
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: An After Effects style Project panel: every file, font, image, model and composition in the project, where each is used, and which are missing or failed.

plugins.name: Precomp+
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.description: Pre-compose selected video clips into compositions, manage them in a Compositions window, and render them nested in Main.

plugins.name: Animated GIF
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.description: Decodes animated GIF image assets and animates them deterministically from clip-local time.

plugins.name: Graph Editor 2
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.description: Replaces the keyframe graph editor with DaviFX's Graph Editor 2: easing presets, tangent tools, ruler scrubbing, a track list with live values and a full keyboard set.

plugins.name: Motion Paths
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.tagline: Editable motion paths in the preview
plugins.description: After Effects style motion paths for animated Position in the preview, with draggable keyframes and bezier handles.

plugins.name: Light+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Upgrades the standard Light button with a chooser for Spot, Point, Directional, and Hemisphere lights.

plugins.name: Geometry+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds rounded boxes, low-poly polyhedra, and procedural primitives to 3D Scene.

plugins.name: Effector
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds procedural repeaters plus Twist, Warp and Voronoi Fracture effectors to 3D Scene.

plugins.name: Material+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds procedural Node Materials with a node editor, PBR+ with ramps, Fresnel, cel shading and projection, Image+ with opacity, Matcap, and corrected-UV materials for 3D objects.

plugins.name: Text+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds per-character animation and 3D face materials to Text, plus advanced 3D bevel controls.

plugins.name: ExpressText+
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.description: Tracks separate 3D text letters and drives them with Shake, Plain, Random, Formula, Delay, Spline, Orbit, Repeater, Twist, Wrap and Voronoi effectors.

plugins.name: Particles+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds original monochrome particle sprites: geometric shapes, pattern textures, and glow/flare variants.

plugins.name: Rowbyte & Red Giant Suite
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.tagline: Particular, Form, Plexus and C4D lights
plugins.description: Trapcode Particular, Form and Plexus 3D objects with floating designer windows, deterministic simulation and audio analysis, plus C4D-style lights.

plugins.name: Optical Flares
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.description: Video Copilot style lens flares placed in 3D space and projected through the scene camera, edited in one floating window.

plugins.name: Effector+
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.description: Loads projects saved with Effector+ (numeric Twist, Warp and Voronoi Fracture types) using the Effector pack implementations.

plugins.name: Camera+
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.description: Adds a separate Camera+ object with depth of field, seeded vibrate and focus tools, Camera layers, and a 3D switch on video tracks that lets scenes and flat layers follow the shared camera. The default CM3 camera is left unchanged.

plugins.name: Native FX
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds native filters, direct visual controls, and time effects.

plugins.name: AfterClip
plugins.author: AfterClip
plugins.description: Adds AfterClip custom shaders and group presets.
plugins.warning: This is a temporary plugin to help AfterClip users migrate to Zoidium. The Zoidium Shader Pack will be developed soon, and this plugin will become outdated.

plugins.name: Afterzoid Shader Pack 5
plugins.author: AlipFX
plugins.description: A rich shader preset pack by AlipFX.

plugins.name: CCFX Shader Pack
plugins.author: CCFX
plugins.description: Adds CCFX shader effects and group presets.

plugins.name: OpenZoid Legacy
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.tagline: Echo, Posterize Time, JPEG, VHS, Datamosh, Tracery
plugins.description: OpenZoid effects on Zoidium deterministic rendering: Echo and Posterize Time (Legacy), Jpeg Damage, VHS, Datamosh, Tracery and ASCII, with floating setup windows.

plugins.name: Magic Looks
plugins.author: DaviFX
plugins.description: Magic Bullet Looks-style color grading: 29 color, light and lens tools in a reorderable chain with look presets and a floating setup window.

plugins.name: Layer Input
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Lets effects, 3D materials, and Custom Shaders use another video track as an information source.
plugins.warning: Layer Input projects require Zoidium. This feature is extremely experimental and may cause unexpected crashes.

plugins.name: Shape+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Animated vector layers, procedural contents, pen masks for Scene and Adjustment layers, SVG import and native preview path editing.

plugins.name: Constraints
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.tagline: Track To and Follow for 3D objects
plugins.description: Adds object constraints to native 3D objects. Track To aims at a target in the same scene. Follow copies position, rotation, and scale from an object in the same scene or another scene layer in the same sequence.
plugins.warning: Projects with constraints require Zoidium. Other builds open the project with its authored transforms.

plugins.name: Node Effect
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Build GPU layer effects with a node graph. Saved effects render through the native Custom Shader.

plugins.name: MP4 Export
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Export MP4 from the native Export panel with AAC or Opus audio. Requires WebCodecs encoder support.
